main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-day fall after new short bets vs coin's falling-agitated grid mean

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; below 0 with t <= -2 to reject; at least 30 case-days

supporting_check.name: unusual move of upper |forecast| half minus lower half

decided_by: t between -2 and 2 (neither confirm nor reject rule met) No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.441 (below 1), 325 cases (30 needed).
reading: the profile is regime 'unknown'; a case is the first new short bet (short forecast magnitude rising >= 2 from its lowest since the last bet) in each 3-bar grid cell from each window's first row, with a 3-bar return inside the window; the baseline pools each coin's profile grid bars over all its windows; the day-pooled t uses a clustered standard error with G/(G-1) correction; the median split puts |forecast| above the median in the upper half and the rest in the lower; fewer than 30 case-days is reported as not observable

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.441 (below 1), 325 cases (30 needed)
